name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success & AI Data Quality | Data Processing, Output Validation, Technical Support
summary: Detail-focused customer success and operations professional who works hands-on with AI systems and the data behind them. At Solenzo I configure and evaluate AI-generated output, built rubric-based grading criteria for an audit process, and do the underlying data labeling myself. I've cleaned a 1,400+ contact CRM, validate every data import, and write working SQL. 15+ years helping SaaS customers get set up and supported, including a 50+ activities-per-day partner desk at Birdeye.
